content.value: The [[item/minecraft:cartography_table|Cartography Table]] uses the shared station interface for supported map creation, copying, expansion and locking. [[item/minecraft:filled_map|Maps]] currently serve their vanilla display and decorative role; this does not introduce an expedition or treasure-chart system.
Select the appropriate operation and eligible map. Each operation retains its own material requirements and resulting map data.
Quantity and total output are shown where the operation supports a batch. Inputs are validated by the station before it changes a map.
